en.tagline: Two photos in, plain-language hair care ideas out.
en.privacy: Privacy: photos are analysed in memory and not saved. The service keeps only counts, such as how many photos were checked.
en.front_why: Face the camera so your hairline is easy to see, in soft, bright light.
en.crown_why: Get a clear view from above, with your hair parted if that helps.
crown_do: Close up: the hair and scalp should fill most of the picture
Part the hair so the scalp shows
Sharp and well lit (tap the screen to focus)
crown_dont: Faces, rooms or walls in the picture
en.empty_hint: Add one or both photos to start. You don't need both.
en.no_model: The AI model for this photo is not installed yet.
en.what_balding: A hairline that has moved back or a bald area at the front or top.
en.what_dryness: Tight, rough or flaky skin without oily buildup.
en.what_dandruff: White or yellowish flakes on the scalp or in the hair.
en.what_low_density: Hair that looks sparse, with more scalp showing through.
en.m_possible: The AI noticed something that looks like this. It is a hint, not a diagnosis.
en.m_none_seen: The AI did not spot a clear sign. This does not prove there is nothing there.
en.m_unsure: The photo isn't clear enough for the AI to decide either way.
en.m_unsuitable: This photo looks very different from the photos the AI learned from, so any answer would be a guess.
en.next_possible: Next: see the care ideas below. If it bothers you or keeps getting worse, ask a doctor or dermatologist.
en.next_none_seen: Next: nothing to do from this result. If you are worried, a professional can check in person.
en.next_unsure: Next: try again with a closer, sharper, brighter photo.
en.next_unsuitable: Next: retake the photo using the tips above.
en.why_unfamiliar: The photo looks somewhat different from the AI's training photos.
en.why_very_unfamiliar: The photo looks very different from the AI's training photos.
en.why_bright: The photo is washed out or too bright.
en.why_small: The photo is small, so detail is lost.
en.why_unstable: The answer changed when the same photo was slightly shifted or zoomed.
en.why_close_call: The AI's answer was too close to call.
en.why_untested: The AI has not been tested on ordinary phone photos, so treat every result as a rough hint.
en.why_no_gate: This model has no photo-familiarity check installed, so its answers are less reliable.
en.adv_intro: For the curious. These numbers are technical and are not percentages of 'how much' of a condition you have.
en.adv_cam: Show a heat map (where the AI looked)
en.adv_cam_warn: Warmer colours mean more influence on the score. A heat map does NOT prove the AI reasoned correctly; use it only as a hint.
en.acc_none: Final test results are not available yet.
en.acc_head: Measured on photos the model had never seen, inside a single photo source (so it can't win by recognising where a photo came from):
en.acc_row: {name}: AUROC {auroc} (95% range {lo}–{hi}), from {n} photos with {pos} positive
en.acc_explain: AUROC is a score from 0.5 (coin flip) to 1.0 (perfect) for how well the AI ranks photos with a condition above photos without.
acc_limits: These photos are mostly close-up stock-style images. The AI has not been tested on ordinary phone photos of your own head, so its accuracy there is unknown.
Some conditions have only a few test examples, so their numbers are rough.
Differences between photo sources (lighting, camera, style) can fool an AI. This app tries to detect that and say 'not sure'.
en.tip_balding: Visible signs of a receding or thin hairline may be present. A gentle volumising shampoo and avoiding tight hairstyles are harmless general steps. Causes vary a lot, so if it is new, spreading or worrying you, a dermatologist can check it properly.
en.tip_dryness: The scalp may be dry. Try a gentle, moisturising shampoo, less hot water and less heat styling. If it stays itchy or sore, ask a pharmacist or doctor.
en.tip_dandruff: Flaking may be present. An anti-dandruff shampoo (for example with zinc pyrithione or ketoconazole) used as the label says is a common first step. If it persists for a few weeks, see a dermatologist.
en.tip_low_density: Hair may look thinner than usual. Many temporary things (stress, diet, illness, hormones) as well as genetics can cause this, and a photo can't tell which. Be gentle with brushing and tight styles, and see a doctor or trichologist to find the cause.
en.multi: More than one possible sign appeared together. That is worth showing to a dermatologist for a full check.
en.general: No clear signs were seen. General habits that help: a gentle shampoo, not too much heat styling, and a balanced diet.
en.retake: For {label}, the result was not reliable. Retake the photo, or have it checked in person if you are concerned.
en.not_assessed: Some parts were not checked because no photo was given for them.
en.not_checked: Add a photo to check this.
en.foot: This tool describes what is visible in a photo. It cannot replace an examination by a doctor.
en.bad_file: That file could not be opened as a picture. Please use a JPG or PNG photo.
en.hero_lede: Add a front photo, a top-of-head photo, or both. You’ll get a plain answer for each.
en.untested_banner: Not yet tested on ordinary phone photos. Every result is a rough hint.
en.guide_front_cap: Front: whole hairline in view, head straight
en.guide_crown_cap: Top: scalp fills the frame, hair parted
en.check_lead: Use one or both. Each photo is compared with the type the AI was trained on.
en.opt_heat: Also show where the AI looked (a little slower)
en.pc_match: Matches the photos the AI learned from.
en.pc_partial: Somewhat different from the training photos. Treat the answer as a rough hint.
en.pc_mismatch: Not the photo type this AI knows, so it was not judged.
en.samples_lead: Photos from free sources, of the type the AI was trained on. Select one to run the check. They are examples only; nobody has confirmed what they show.
en.samples_empty: No sample photos yet. Add images to the demo_samples folder and reload the page.
en.how_lead: Every photo passes the same five steps. Nothing is saved.
en.how1_d: Read in memory, turned upright, shrunk to 1024 px.
en.how2_d: Compared with the training photos. A very different photo is refused.
en.how3_d: One reads the front photo, one the top-of-head photo (MobileNetV2).
en.how4_d: The photo is shifted, zoomed and mirrored. If the answer flips, the result is “not sure”.
en.how5_d: Possible sign, no clear sign, not sure or can’t judge, plus how far to trust it.
en.acc_single: One photo source only, so likely optimistic.
en.acc_lim_title: What we do not know yet
en.mon_lead: Counts only. Photos are never stored.
en.mon_none: No checks yet. The figures appear after the first photo is checked.
en.mon_why: A rising share of unfamiliar photos is how drift shows up.
en.err_unsupported_type: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
en.err_too_large: That photo is larger than 10 MB. Pick a smaller one.
en.err_unreadable: That file could not be opened as a photo.
en.err_too_small: That photo is too small. Use one at least 64 pixels on its short side.
en.err_model_missing: The AI model for this photo is not installed on the server.
en.err_bad_request: The request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
en.err_network: Can't reach the server. Check that it is running, then try again.
en.hero_note: No need for a perfect photo. Just choose a clear, well-lit one that feels right to share.
en.art_note: Small steps toward understanding your hair.
en.check_note: One photo is enough to begin.
en.photo_privacy: Experimental tool, not a medical diagnosis. Your photos are checked in memory and are not saved. Only counts and timings are kept.
en.res_h_possible: Something may be worth a closer look.
en.res_h_unsure: We couldn’t be sure this time.
en.res_s_possible: This looks like a possible sign, not a diagnosis. Changes can happen gradually, and a photo can only tell us so much. Possible:
en.res_s_none_seen: We didn’t spot a clear sign in your photos. That doesn’t prove there is nothing there, and a photo can only tell us so much.
en.res_s_unsure: Some photos weren’t clear enough to give a firm answer. A closer, sharper, brighter photo usually helps.
en.res_s_unsuitable: It looks like this may not be a photo of your hair or scalp, so any answer would be a guess. A clear, well-lit photo usually works best.
en.res_meta: A photo-based estimate, not a medical diagnosis.
en.band_t: Want to know how we reached this result?
en.band_d: See what the model looks for, what it can miss, and how to read the result.
en.limits_link: What this check can and can’t tell you
en.how_lead_simple: Three simple steps, and nothing is saved.
en.hs1_d: A clear, well-lit front or top-of-head photo works best.
en.hs2_d: It first checks the photo suits the check, then looks for signs it has learned from example photos.
en.hs3_d: Each answer comes with how far to trust it, and what to do next.
en.more_d: See how the photo is checked, how it was tested, and where its limits are.
en.det_lead: The technical side of the check: what happens to a photo, how the models were tested, and what the numbers do and don’t mean.
en.acc_intervals: The bar around each dot is a 95% range worked out by resampling the test photos. A wider bar means the number is less certain.
en.acc_not_phone: These numbers describe the test photos only. They are not a promise about ordinary phone photos of your own head, which have not been tested.
en.acc_balding_note: The balding result comes from a single photo source, so there was no style-free check and it is probably optimistic. Other conditions have few test examples, so their ranges are wide.
en.ver_lead: The models currently running in this service.
en.mon_unreachable: Can’t reach the service right now, so no figures are available.
en.mon_explain: These figures come from the service’s own request log. It keeps counts, timings and result types, never photos. A rising share of unfamiliar photos is the early warning that the photos people send no longer look like the ones the AI learned from.
en.why_blank: The photo has almost no detail (a plain colour or blank surface).
en.checking_hint: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
en.err_timeout: The check is taking too long. Check that the server is running, then try again.
en.err_server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Your photos are still here. Try again.
en.err_too_many_pixels: That photo has too many pixels. Pick a smaller one.
en.find_lead: What each photo suggests, in plain words. These are hints from a photo, not a diagnosis.
en.care_lead: Gentle, general steps. They are ideas to try, not a treatment plan.
en.help_lead: A photo cannot tell why something is happening. Consider seeing a dermatologist, doctor or pharmacist if:
en.help_1: it is new, spreading or getting worse
en.help_2: your scalp is itchy, sore, red or painful
en.help_3: flaking or thinning goes on for more than a few weeks
en.help_4: it worries you, even when the result says no clear sign

th.tip_balding: อาจมีสัญญาณของแนวผมร่นหรือผมบางที่ไรผม การใช้แชมพูที่ช่วยให้ผมพองและเลี่ยงทรงผมที่ดึงรั้งเป็นวิธีทั่วไปที่ไม่เป็นอันตราย สาเหตุแตกต่างกันมาก หากเพิ่งเป็น ลุกลาม หรือกังวล ควรให้แพทย์ผิวหนังตรวจอย่างละเอียด
th.tip_dryness: หนังศีรษะอาจแห้ง ลองใช้แชมพูอ่อนโยนที่เพิ่มความชุ่มชื้น ลดน้ำร้อนและการใช้ความร้อนกับเส้นผม หากยังคันหรือเจ็บ ควรปรึกษาเภสัชกรหรือแพทย์
th.tip_dandruff: อาจมีขุยรังแค แชมพูขจัดรังแค (เช่นที่มีซิงค์ไพริไทออนหรือคีโตโคนาโซล) ใช้ตามฉลากเป็นขั้นแรกที่นิยม หากไม่ดีขึ้นใน 2-3 สัปดาห์ ควรพบแพทย์ผิวหนัง
